verifications.note:
Verified adversarially on candidate 5ff36f6e (freeze afba46f, source ccc37c9). I used a disposable complete clone, Node 22 with LANG unset, and a disposable PostgreSQL per probe.

(1) My round-3 reproduction, probe GC rev 2, re-run UNCHANGED: 2/2 pass, where round 3 had 1 failed by design. The world is SAR margin_uplift 70 plus USD revenue_uplift 11. The USD profit-and-cash 'Planned value' headline is not_applicable (no_profit_and_cash_benefit). Its drilldownHref now ends '&currency=USD', and the drill-down returns value {not_applicable, currency USD, no_profit_and_cash_benefit} with items []. The USD Finance gross planned line has the same href and the same result. The SAR gross line and the SAR headline both drill to SAR 70 with the one SAR item.

(2) New probe GX, 151/151:
- Hrefs: all 58 value headline and Finance line hrefs (T10 value area, workspace header, Finance headlines and lines) name their own currency; missingCurrency=[].
- Sums: for every Finance line and T10 value headline, the items' decimal sum equals the figure, no item is in another currency, and every n/a figure drills to no item.
- No currency: the round-3 URL, which named no currency, now returns not_applicable dashboard.value.multiple_currencies in this two-currency scope, never the SAR figure for USD.
- Input handling: 'usd', 'Usd', 'US', 'USDD', '', 'U5D', ' USD', 'SAR,USD', 'SÄR' and a repeated parameter all give 400 validation.invalid_format on /query/currency. 'SAR%00' gives 400 validation.invalid_character.
- Unknown codes: the well-formed unknown code XYZ gives 200 with currency echoed and no item, on all nine accepting metrics. It is not_applicable no_financial_benefit, except value.investment, which is a known zero as the contract text documents.
- Other metrics: all eight non-value metrics give 422 dashboard.currency_not_applicable at /currency.
- Cursor: a cursor issued without currency is refused with currency, and vice versa (400; the filter hash binds it).

(3) Scope: currency cannot widen it. I swept TL1 (T1 only) over 9 metrics x {SAR, USD, EUR} x valueClass {none and the applicable classes}, 117 cases, with T2 holding USD 5000, SAR 7000 and EUR 900:
- with no filter or a T1 filter, the response equals AUD's T1 response;
- with a T2 or T1+T2 filter, it is 404;
- no T2 id or code appears in any body.
ADM-only and the outsider are refused (4xx) with nothing disclosed. A T2 subjectId with a currency is never 200 (63 calls, all 422). The control shows AUD with no filter seeing T2's USD 5000, so the probe can detect a leak. The round-3 drill-scope probe DS, re-run unchanged, passes 163/163.

Residuals, judged not worth a finding:
(a) value.investment with a currency that has no investment line, even a code the scope never uses, answers a known zero, not not_applicable. The contract (getDashboardDrilldown 'currency' description) documents this, and only a hand-written URL reaches it, because no product href names a currency outside the scope.
(b) The USD Finance gross line is still a known 0 beside the n/a USD profit-and-cash headline, and its drill-down is n/a. The figure-to-drill invariant holds (0 = the sum of no item). The line state is KBE-R6's disclosed design choice (a), which is the domain reviewer's call.
(c) Without currency, the multiple_currencies drill-down lists only the basis's records (the SAR item), not the USD top-line one. That is consistent with 'records of the basis'.
